protocol_version_note: The governing filename is summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md, while its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. The exact filename was treated as authoritative per project precedence.
schema_gaps: The quantitative_result atom kind requires exposures even for purely descriptive prevalence/timepoint comparisons. Noncausal cohort/episode descriptors were used as exposure/comparator context and tagged where relevant.
extraction_limitations: The recurrent cohort contains only 13 patients and the analysis is descriptive.
The supplied article references the recurrent-GBS definition to Kuitwaard et al. without restating the criteria.
Two of 20 patients with prior acute polyradiculoneuritis were excluded because of “comorbidities,” but the reason is not specified.
Several first-versus-recurrent comparisons report only P > 0.05 without exact p-values or confidence intervals; this does not establish equivalence.
Treatment patterns differed strongly between first and recurrent attacks, limiting causal interpretation of disability comparisons.
The supplied PDF prints PMID as “xxxx”; no external correction was introduced because @VERIFY was not activated.
Patient 12’s Table 1 interval cell is printed as “6” without a unit; it is preserved as unresolved.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human verification step is represented.
